summary: Commission grid v3 acceptance matrix (6 criteria) verified: 5 new backend test files (6 tests) + 6 new browser checks, all passing. Feature was already implemented server+client side (RuleDialog age/fuel chips, masters age_bands/fuel_types, new PRODUCT_CATEGORIES, bundle derivation, lib/commission.py matching on vehicle_ages/fuel_types). No app bugs found.

checks.criterion: Add many rules without closing the dialog
checks.name: commission-save-and-add-next-keeps-dialog-open
checks.evidence: Admin > Commission > Receivable > Add rule. Selected insurer Go Digit (avoids overlap with seeded ICICI payable rules), filled name+OD%, clicked rule-save-next-button: toast with name, dialog stayed open, insurer condition kept, name+od_percent cleared, rule-added-count showed '1 rule added...' then '2 rules added...' after a second add, row appeared in receivable-rules-table each time. Final rule-save-button ('Save & close') closed the dialog. 3 fixture rules (tscheck-multi-*) deleted after run.

checks.criterion: Saved rules apply to existing MIS policies immediately
checks.name: test_tscheck_rule_applies_live_to_existing_policy.py
checks.evidence: Inserted a policy directly (no rule yet) -> GET /policies/{id}/commission receivable=None. Created a matching receivable rule via POST /commission/rules -> same GET now returns receivable=1000 (10% of 10000 OD) and receivable_rule_name, with no re-upload of the policy; policy also present in GET /api/policies listing. Fixtures deleted in finally.

checks.criterion: Vehicle age bands for all products
checks.name: commission-rule-vehicle-age-bands-all-products
checks.evidence: rule-age chip group with all 7 bands (New Vehicle...Above 15 Years) visible for All products and for Private Car/Two Wheeler/PCV/GCV/Misc D product types; chip toggled to selected state on click.

checks.name: test_tscheck_vehicle_age_band_match.py
checks.evidence: Rule vehicle_ages=['New Vehicle']. Policy with registration_date==start_date (2026-01-10) -> receivable_rule_name == rule name. Policy with registration_date 2017 (~9yr old, band '8-10 Years') -> receivable_rule_name != rule name. Fixtures deleted in finally.

checks.name: commission-rule-fuel-type-private-car-only
checks.evidence: rule-fuel chip group (Petrol/Diesel/CNG/LPG/Electric/Hybrid) visible only when product type = Private Car; absent (count 0) for Two Wheeler/PCV/GCV.

checks.name: test_tscheck_fuel_type_match.py
checks.evidence: Rule fuel_types=['Diesel']. Policy fields.fuel_type='Diesel' -> receivable_rule_name == rule name. Policy fuel_type='Petrol' -> receivable_rule_name != rule name. Fixtures deleted in finally.

checks.name: commission-rule-new-product-options-present
checks.evidence: rule-product-select options include 'Private Car 1+3 (Bundle)' and 'Private Car 1+5 (Long Term)' under Private Car, 'Two Wheeler 1+5 (Bundle)' under Two Wheeler, 'Misc D - Tractor' and 'Misc D - Others' under Misc D.

checks.name: test_tscheck_new_product_categories.py
checks.evidence: GET /commission/masters product_types includes all 4 new codes. A policy inserted with cover_type=Package, start_date=2026-10-01, tp_end_date=2029-09-30 (3yr TP window) -> GET /policies/{id} fields.product_category == 'Private Car 1+3 (Bundle)' (derived server-side, not stored).

checks.criterion: NCB 'All' for every product; PCV seating
checks.name: commission-rule-ncb-all-and-pcv-seating
checks.evidence: rule-ncb-select with option 'All (with & without NCB)' visible for All products and for each of Private Car/Two Wheeler/PCV/GCV/Misc D/Health/Others. PCV shows rule-seating-min/rule-seating-max. Run against public preview URL https://insurance-mis-portal.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.criterion: NCB 'All' matching incl. Misc D and Health (API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_ncb_any_all_products.py
checks.evidence: Two receivable rules (ncb='any') for Misc D - Tractor and Health products matched their respective fixture policies regardless of ncb_percent (not set) via GET /policies/{id}/commission -> receivable_rule_name == rule name for both. Fixtures deleted in finally.

checks.criterion: PCV seating matching (API, pre-existing coverage re-verified)
checks.name: test_tscheck_pcv_seating_match.py
checks.evidence: Pre-existing file from iteration 7 re-run clean: seating_min=10/max=40 rule matches seating_capacity=32, not 5.

action_items: Pre-existing, out-of-scope (confirmed again, matches iteration 6/7 notes): running the FULL backend suite under default pytest-xdist parallelism (`python -m pytest -q`) shows ~40 failures across older test files (auth/login lockout races, health-endpoint timing, OCR timing) due to concurrent workers sharing the same admin session / rate-limit state. All files pass cleanly when run together without xdist contention (verified test_tscheck_commission_policy_calc.py + test_tscheck_health_endpoint.py individually: 4 passed). Not re-diagnosed further as it is unrelated to the commission grid v3 criteria tested this iteration and was already flagged twice before.
